主題: Upcoming Terms of Use changes on Sketchfab

寄件人: Sketchfab Support <support@sketchfab.com>

收件人: <ptest9109@gmail.com>

日期: Mon, 10 Nov 2025 17:40:57 +0000

標籤: UNREAD, CATEGORY_UPDATES, INBOX

內容:
Hello, We’re writing to let you know about some upcoming updates to [Sketchfab’s Terms of Use](https://r.email1.sketchfab.com/mk/cl/f/sh/28xHLtxYQ4yZ42UyOfEfZ3uUsmN8VKH0Fu/iBDMpAOVfngLterms) that will take effect on December 11, 2025. Here’s what’s changing: 1. New users who sign up to Sketchfab once the new terms go into effect will use Epic Games accounts. - If you already have a Sketchfab account, nothing changes for you—you can continue to log in to Sketchfab as you always have. 2. Any 3D asset created with Generative AI Programs must be labeled as “CreatedWithAI”. - Previously, we had only required the “CreatedWithAI” label on models that were made available for sale or download—now the requirement applies to every AI-generated model you upload, whether you make it downloadable or not. - In some cases, if we detect that models have been created with Generative AI Programs, we may assign the “CreatedWithAI” label to those models. - This helps maintain transparency across the community and makes it easier to discover the type of content you’re most interested in. New search filters—which rely upon accurate labeling of models as “CreatedWithAI”—will enable you to find or exclude AI-generated content. You can review the updated Terms of Use here: [https://r.email1.sketchfab.com/mk/cl/f/sh/8qyleR3u7gcTgWYUVkj8ChNVC4ofjgv8sZG/-OyLTDXN60oAblogs/community/sketchfab-terms-of-use-update/](https://r.email1.sketchfab.com/mk/cl/f/sh/28xHLtxYQ4zbPDpFvjduc0BfkawrfDxB7y/34gqs2RYD92b). Thank you for being part of the Sketchfab community. The Sketchfab Team Sketchfab, Inc., 440 Ninth Ave., Suite 1700, New York, New York 10001 This email was sent to ptest9109@gmail.com because you are a registered Sketchfab user. 主題: 小米發布會

寄件人: "陳俞蓁(yu_chen)" <yu_chen@phison.com>

收件人: "ptest9109@gmail.com" <ptest9109@gmail.com>

日期: Wed, 8 Oct 2025 05:49:50 +0000

標籤: CATEGORY_PERSONAL, INBOX

內容:
Hello everyone, Xiaomi's autumn new product launch conference is starting now. Five years ago, we started the high-end development of our mobile phone business and officially began to compete with Apple. After five years of hard work, we have made tremendous progress. Today, we bring you the annual blockbuster new product, Xiaomi 17. The standard version of Xiaomi 17 is the strongest small-sized all-round flagship in Xiaomi's history, with an all- round upgrade. First of all, the texture has been greatly upgraded. Because we want to be high-end, texture is very important. I use four words to describe the changes in Xiaomi 17: stunning transformation. I think everyone can re-acquaint themselves with Xiaomi mobile phones. You can take a closer look. First of all, the screen is very, very beautiful. The 2D pure screen has an extremely narrow bezel of only 1.18 mm, reaching the top level in the industry. The proportions of the whole machine have also been fine-tuned to make it more stretched and beautiful. The mouthpiece also adopts a lightweight design. The transparent camera base effectively reduces the bulge and heaviness of the camera. The metal middle frame has a reverse-wrapped design and feels very sturdy. The sophistication of all the details is no less than that of the iPhone. You can really compare it. It is made very, very exquisitely. The 6.3-inch screen is only 8.06 mm thick. It weighs only 191 grams. This size, weight and thickness are very, very comfortable. The oversized R-angle design makes the shape more rounded. This is a super-elliptical design with continuous curves. It is equipped with Xiaomi Crystal Glass, which is 10 times stronger than ordinary glass. The middle frame is made of high-strength aviation aluminum, which is durable, fully waterproof and dustproof, and the quality is more reliable. It supports IP66, IP68 with a 4-meter waterproof rating, and IP69. Oh, and this time there are four colors to choose from. The back bar is made of glass with a high-end matte texture. Let me especially introduce these two new colors: Snow Mountain Pink, which is beautiful, and Ice Melt Blue. This generation of Xiaomi 17 has a major performance upgrade. First of all, it is equipped with Qualcomm's latest and most advanced processor, the fifth-generation Snapdragon 8 Extreme Edition. It is also the world's first launch. Its performance and power consumption have reached the peak level of flagship phones. Let's take a look. Its CPU is built with a 3nm manufacturing process, which is faster and more energy-efficient. Its CPU uses an octa- core architecture, and the super-large core uses the third-generation Orin architecture. Its main screen reaches 4.6GHz. This is the highest a mobile phone SoC can achieve. Currently, its performance rivals Apple's in both multi-core and single-core performance. The latest A49 Pro processor consumes 35% less power than the previous generation, and its GPU's independent cache has increased by 50%. Its performance far exceeds that of the A19 Pro, and its power consumption is 20% lower than the previous generation. The three-dimensional ring-shaped cooling pump system has a heat dissipation capacity three times that of a typical VC vapor chamber, so its performance and heat dissipation are exceptional. Compare it to the iPhone 17. And when gaming heavily with the highest quality, our frame rates are higher and temperatures are lower. After three hours of gaming, our frame rate and temperature performance remain superior. In various additional usage scenarios, our temperature control performance is indeed superior compared to the iPhone. The reason is simple: our standard version is designed as a Pro model, meaning our performance is close to that of the iPhone 17 Pro. Furthermore, our heat dissipation capacity is also exceptional, so our performance is indeed superior. The screen upgrade is also significant: a 6.3-inch OLED screen with 120Hz and adaptive high refresh rate, ensuring clear and smooth viewing of any content. With a peak brightness of 3,500 nits, it's easily readable even outdoors, and it 's more power-efficient. This outstanding performance stems from the latest generation of screen illumination technology, M10. The M10 achieves the industry's highest luminous efficiency, meaning it's brighter and more power-efficient. Fortunately, this generation of screen technology has seen a key breakthrough in the red luminescent material of OLED, increasing its luminous efficiency by 11.4% to 2812.1%. This technology comes from Nubia, a domestic manufacturer in which Xiaomi has made a strategic investment. Our joint laboratory has jointly completed the verification and mass production of the new material, which has been successfully applied in the mass production of the Xiaomi Mi 17. This is a major breakthrough in OLED's underlying material technology. This also marks the first time a domestic manufacturer has domestically produced this luminescent material, achieving international leadership right out of the gate. Let's hear more about it. Luminescent materials are the core of OLED and directly determine the performance of the entire display. Therefore, if our domestic screens are to be strong and world-leading, we must start with the underlying luminescent materials and lay a solid foundation for development. This time, we've invented a new red halogen-based luminescent material. It performs better than the best imported materials. In the true sense, it has achieved global leadership. Is n't it amazing? Because today we must not only lead in terminals and applications, but also in core technologies and materials science. We are also making breakthroughs step by step. Of course, when it comes to the Xiaomi 17, as a small-sized flagship, battery life has always been a huge challenge due to its small size. So how is the battery life of the Xiaomi 17 this time? It's extremely exaggerated. 7,000 mAh, almost twice that of the iPhone 17. There are many major breakthroughs in this. Let's take a look together. It also supports 100W wired fast charging and 50W wireless fast charging. It has 1,600 mAh more than the Xiaomi 15 and 3,300 mAh more than the iPhone 17. The most important reason is the latest generation of battery technology. The Xiaomi Jinshajiang battery contains up to 16% silicon. It not only achieves ultra-high energy density, but also achieves super low-temperature endurance and an ultra-long life of 5 years. So today 's battery technology is also changing with each passing day. Well, let's compare the battery life with the iPhone again. It may be a bit unfair. Let's take a look. Oh oh oh Everyone knows why we call it Xiaomi 17, because it is too powerful. Of course, some netizens also suggested to us that why not call it Xiaomi 18. Well, we should take it easy, take it easy. Okay, everyone should be able to see that the battery life of Xiaomi 17 is better than that of iPhone 17. If we use a 5,000mAh power bank, we can compare the results. When they are completely out of power, we still have 26%. So Xiaomi 17 not only beats iPhone 17, but it also beats all models in the iPhone 17 series in actual tests. With such a terrifying battery life, it is definitely the well-deserved king of small-size battery life. Its imaging is also particularly outstanding, Leica imaging, three 50-megapixel Leica professional lenses, Leica main camera, Leica ultra-wide angle, and 2.6x Leica floating telephoto. Its standard version has a telephoto, and it is a floating telephoto. Well, its blockage is particularly severe. Here, our product manager reminded me that it must be made clear. It is the Light Hunter 950, it has a super large bottom of 1 point 1/3, and this is a Pro-level main camera. It's much stronger than the sensors of similar-priced phones. I really want to highlight this. So, in terms of optical capabilities, it has a net resistance of G plus P. I don't know, do you know G plus P? In fact, a glass lens is added to the lens group of this camera, which is rare in the same class. Moreover, each lens is coated, which greatly improves the overall image quality and cleanliness. Okay, let's take a look at the sample photos. The performance at all focal lengths is very good, reaching the best level in Xiaomi's history. In low light, backlight, and various complex light conditions, the pictures are very, very transparent. Especially the new generation of master portraits, the underlying technology has been completely reconstructed. For example, the skin color of the characters maintains the Leica flavor while being real and natural. Let's take a look at its magic master. The processing level has been greatly improved, comparable to professional cameras, with every fiber clearly visible. The front camera has also been upgraded to a 50-megapixel super-steel and super-sensitive camera. The large bottom and large aperture make the selfie effect even better. So, speaking of this, the product strength of Xiaomi 17 is off the charts, and it has even reached the Pro level. Its processor, its heat dissipation, and its camera are actually at the Pro level. So, compared with the iPhone Compared to the previous generation iPhone 17, this generation iPhone 17 is also very good. I saw some online media reviews saying it was squeezed out of the toothpaste. But if you compare it with the Xiaomi 17 on a 1:1 basis, I think there is definitely still a gap in hardware configuration. Of course, there is still a lot for us to learn from the iPhone. Well, our Xiaomi 17 is also a comprehensive upgrade compared to the previous generation Xiaomi 15. Let's highlight the key points. In these five areas, Xiaomi phones have made tremendous progress. First of all, the performance is very outstanding. It uses the latest and most advanced Qualcomm processor. Then, its small size and ultimate feel. Moreover, its screen is very good and the battery life is extremely good. With Leica imaging, how much will it cost with so many new features? Mr. Lu revealed the answer last week. It's more functionality without increasing the price. It's still 4,499, okay? I hope to get your support, especially friends in the media. Don't think that Xiaomi phones have done nothing in the past five years. We have really put in a lot of effort, okay? Okay, next we will release the Pro all-round technology imaging flagship. The Xiaomi 17 Pro series is officially comparable to the iPhone. We also have two models, one large and one small, and all... It's powered by the fifth-generation Snapdragon 8 Extreme Edition, a global debut. The biggest feature of our Xiaomi 17 Pro series is the Wonderful Back Screen. We've invested heavily in this back screen. We've customized two flagship-grade OLED screens for each phone, one large and one small, and fully covered them with high-strength Xiaomi Dragon Crystal Glass, so there's no need to worry about scratches. So, what can this expensive back screen do? Let's take a look. First, it has a variety of fun clocks. You can even raise a koi fish on it to bring the back screen to life. Furthermore, you can display photos of family and idols, use AI to generate various styles, and animate them. There's also AI pets, which support a variety of styles. It also serves as a notification bar for important information, such as flight and train itineraries, show tickets, and more. It can also play music and control our Xiaomi Car. The back screen has many other features. Let me introduce a few: The back screen selfie function uses the primary color for ultra-high-definition selfies, ultra-wide-angle group photos, telephoto shots of makeup details, and even a photo booth mode. Rich templates, multiple continuous shots, after taking, you can print them out with one click using the Mijia photo printer. How is it? Good. Also, it is very convenient to help others take pictures. You can use the back screen to preview the composition and pose. I guess it can reduce a lot of family conflicts. Hahaha. In addition, the back screen sticky notes prompt various important information. Circle the information you see on the front screen, and you can immediately piece it onto the back screen. What else can you piece together? For example, the pick-up code when ordering food, the QR code, or even a photo can be pieced onto the back screen. It's very magical. What else can you do? Some netizens suggested that it is possible to install a handle and turn it into a game console. This time there is really a retro handheld game console protective case. This one is for when you don't have a signal on the plane, you can use it to play a few small games. It 's very exciting. I tried it too and couldn't stop. They were all those fun small games we played when we were kids. The thickness is about the same as a silicone protective case. You can use it as a silicone protective case and occasionally take it out to show off to your friends. This thing is pretty good. So the whole MiShare back screen can make the phone more interesting and more exciting. : Look at the Xiaomi 17 Pro Max I just got. How come there is an extra screen? Hmm, it looks good. You can also take selfies on the back. It's very photogenic. Hey, this fish is interesting. Wow hahaha wow your car, hmm, that's what I expected. You can control it remotely here. Amazing. With an extra screen, everyone can use it more happily. This is the strength of Xiaomi's intelligent technology innovation. The more such innovations, the more beautiful our lives will be. The more aspects, the more wonderful the Xiaomi 17 Pro series. So, the entire Xiaomi 17 Pro series, this wonderful accessory, is very, very interesting. This time, we also offer four colors to choose from. There is the black that everyone wants, and there is also the white that everyone wants. We have also added two new colors. One is Deep Eye Green, which is calm and restrained. Cold Smoke Purple adds a touch of gray to the purple, which is soft and restrained. This color has been on the hot search as soon as it was released. What do you think? It's good because it comes in two sizes, one large and one small. Let's first look at the Xiaomi 17 Pro, a very powerful and small-sized Pro, to see what its strengths are. First of all, its strength lies in the imaging of the Pro machine, which also has a Leica triple camera, covering image creation at a full focal length, especially It has a shallow- scope 5x Leica floating telephoto lens, supports 10x lossless zoom, and 20cm macro shooting. Okay, let's take a look at how this periscope lens is made. First, the floating telephoto lens has two sets of optical lenses, which are then transformed into a three-refractive prism structure to complete the entire periscope process. Such outstanding innovation. They are 54% smaller than the previous generation and occupy 43% less motherboard area. Because for the entire small-sized flagship, the most important thing is miniaturization. How to achieve the original function or even more powerful functions, and then make it smaller and more precise? This is a particularly high challenge for small-sized flagships. Okay, so let's take a look at the sample photos. Its performance at all focal lengths is very good, and the image quality at telephoto is also very, very amazing. Not only that, the Xiaomi 17 Pro has also achieved a major innovation, which is backlit snapshot. Snapping photos is difficult in itself, and backlit snapshots are even more difficult. So how did we do it this time? First, we use a G-beam and P-beam hybrid lens, which contains glass lenses, each of which is individually coated. It's a coating grand slam, so the image quality is very pure. Let 's take a look at the sample photos. It significantly reduces ghosting and glare, and the backlit images are very clear and transparent under strong light. Then we also use a brand new top-level sensor, the LightHunter 950L. The "L" adds an "L" to it, which represents the ultra-large sensor, ultra-large pixels, and ultra-large aperture. This "L" represents a revolutionary technology for the future. Why don't I call it a revolutionary technology? This Norfolk technology can achieve a dynamic range of a single-frame image that is comparable to the dynamic range of the original three-frame composite. This is a first in the history of mobile phone photography. What is its biggest benefit? Not only is it good for backlit photos, but also for videos with high dynamic range, it can capture very clear videos. So this is very powerful. What is its dynamic range? 16.5 EV. Many people who don't know much about photography may not know what 16.5 EV means. It is more than 50 times that of the one-inch IMAX 989. I don't know if you still remember that we customized a super large sensor from Sony The one- inch camera has a very high dynamic range. Today's model is over 50 times that of that time. Okay, let's take a look at the sample photos. This one was taken with the 17 Pro, and this one was taken with an iPhone. You'll see how big the difference is. Let's take a look at the second and third groups. Let's take a look at the video results. So, thanks to this nophic, we can capture the dynamic range of a professional camera with our phone. To do this, we invited Tim from Film and Television Hurricane to try out our phone. Let's hear what Tim has to say. Hello, I'm Tim. Golden hour is probably familiar to everyone. It usually refers to the time of day around sunrise and sunset. When the sun is low, the light is most expressive. However, golden hour is not easy to capture, especially when shooting against backlight. It's easy to have to choose between the sky and the subject's details. However, the Xiaomi 17 Pro will give us some different results. How does the Xiaomi 17 Pro manage to preserve both shadow and highlight details in backlight? The key here is a new sensor technology called LOFI. Its full name is lateral overflow integral capacitance technology. Simply put, this technology is based on each pixel. An extra large capacitor is added. When the amount of charge converted by the highlight exceeds the limit that the main pixel can carry, the overflow will be transferred to this extra capacitor instead of being directly discarded, resulting in loss of details. It is like light is water and the capacitor in the sensor is a bottle. When there is a larger bottle that can hold the water overflowing from the smaller bottle, the highlight part of the picture will naturally not be easily overexposed. Through the sample photos we shot, you can also find that when shooting in backlight, Xiaomi 17 Pro can retain the highlights of the sky in the picture to the greatest extent. The dark details of the characters will also have a more natural transition. And for indoor and outdoor scenes with high light ratios like this, Xiaomi 17 Pro can also capture clear details indoors while retaining the scenery outside the window. We tested Xiaomi 17 Pro and its dynamic range has reached 16.5 stops, which is enough to compete with professional movie cameras. And because it is a single-frame synthesis, it does not consume too much computing power, so the picture you see on the screen is almost the same as the final film. After a lot of actual shooting, we can say that this Xiaomi 17 Pro is a well-deserved king of backlight, is n't it nova This technology is truly amazing. It's truly exceptional when it comes to taking backlit photos and videos. This incredibly powerful, small-sized Pro model, even with a rear screen, a swaying image, and a periscope, is still only 8mm thick and weighs 192 grams. Amazing, isn't it? When I saw this number, I didn't feel... I don't know if you're a little worried about its battery life. It's the same as the standard version, but it has a rear screen, a periscope, and Pro-level images. With the same thickness and weight, how's its battery life? It still boasts 6,300mAh. Wow, today's technology is truly remarkable. Compared to the entire iPhone lineup, its battery life is excellent. You might be curious how this was achieved. Why did the Xiaomi Mi 17 take such a big step forward? I think our engineers have made a lot of technological innovations in engineering stacking. First, we've further improved the motherboard's integration, achieving the smallest motherboard area in Xiaomi's history. We've adopted a three-layer stacking technology and a discrete design, making it 34% smaller than the previous generation. In such a small area, we've packed over 4,500 components. We also used AI simulation technology to redesign the entire metal midframe structure, significantly improving its strength while reducing weight and saving a significant amount of space. We also adopted the latest battery technology, the Xiaomi Jinshajiang battery, which has a 16% silicon content. More importantly, we used special-shaped laminated battery technology for the first time, increasing the battery capacity by 11.4%, to approximately 720 mAh. You know how we achieved this, right? Of course, this technology doesn't come without a price. It's very expensive. Currently, only Apple uses it, and Xiaomi is the second. It's called special-shaped disc battery technology. We also support UWB, which is expected to be used as a car key. It's extremely easy to use. Let me give you a brief introduction. For example, when you're two or three meters away from the car, the car senses your approach and turns on the welcome lights and unlocks the car. This makes it safer to use. With a Bluetooth car key, your car might unlock even after several meters. And on rainy days, it's inconvenient to hold things in both hands. You can stand on the trunk for a while, and the trunk will automatically open. It's very elegant. When you leave the car, it can also automatically lock. This is because UWB can accurately determine direction and distance. This is the Xiaomi 17 Pro we brought you today. It's very powerful. Under the premise of being equally light and thin, it has a more unique back screen than the standard version, a 950L sensor, LOFEK, a 5x floating periscope telephoto lens, a special-shaped disc battery, and upgraded UWB ultra-wideband interconnection. Of course, there are many other technologies. So how much is the price? We priced it at 4,999, and the starting price is only 500 yuan more expensive than the standard version. And compared with the iPhone 17 Pro, I think we are also quite strong. It is 4,000 yuan cheaper than the iPhone 17 Pro. So this 17PRO is the one I strongly recommend, and I personally chose the 17PRO among the three models. Okay, finally, let me introduce you to the 17 Pro Max. Many people like large screens. This time, we also learned from the iPhone and made a 6.9-inch ultra-large straight screen. The whole phone is 8mm thick and only 219 grams. In fact, for a mobile phone, every gram of weight makes a special experience. What about the iPhone? It is 8.75mm thick. 231 grams is quite heavy. We have the same screen size, and it's only 8 mm thick and only 219 grams. If you have time, you can go to Xiaomi Store to weigh it. The experience is very different. First of all, as a large-screen mobile phone, our screen has been greatly upgraded and is equipped with the latest generation of screen technology. This technology is also very explosive. What is it called ? It's called super pixel. Today, I don't want to turn this press conference into a classroom or popular science class, so I will try to explain the problem in a simple way. So what is super pixel? It is OLED technology. It is actually quite difficult. In traditional OLED technology, it is impossible to display a complete pixel. It is often composed of three adjacent dots. Pixel arrangement is used to display a dot. In other words, a pixel is composed of three surrounding dots. Why is this? Because of technical limitations, it is impossible to put RGB dots in a pixel. So we came up with this very genius idea called Penta or diamond arrangement. So what is super pixel? This is the first time that ORA has put RGB dots in a pixel. Do you understand how big a breakthrough this technology is? The owner has been working on it for so many years. For the first time, we've integrated RGB into a single pixel, bringing truly stunning changes. First, compared to traditional 2K OLED screens, this one has more sub-pixels, yet achieves the same clarity. With more sub-pixels, it's not only more power-efficient than a 2K screen, it's even more power-efficient than a 1.5K screen. So, the display quality is truly incredible. Then, let's look at the iPhone, which has a 1.5K screen. Our display clarity is comparable to a 2K screen, but it's not only sharper but also more power-efficient. This is the latest in screen technology, and we believe it's nearly perfect, offering both ultra-high clarity and exceptional power efficiency. This is the incredibly powerful and advanced screen technology we've brought to the 17 Pro: Super Pixel. With such a premium screen, we've equipped it with the latest, third-generation Xiaomi Dragon Crystal Glass, which boasts 20 times greater drop resistance. Let's take a look. So, this rich gold glass is incredibly powerful. Now, let's take a look at the image. It's also equipped with the Light and Shadow Lover 950L sensor, featuring three professional lenses. Backlit photography is also exceptional. So, what does it add to the 17 Pro? The large-bottom, shallow-focus, and telephoto lens uses a large sensor. Because of its large size, the size of its telephoto sensor reaches 1/2 inch, with a super-large aperture and support for hardware-level HDR. Compared with the iPhone, its sensor area is 35% larger. As you all know, sensor area is very important. It also uses a new super-focusing lens. It is a focusing lens. This focusing lens can significantly increase the amount of light entering, which can be increased by 30% compared to the previous generation. First of all, it has a large bottom. Secondly, it uses a focusing, super-focusing prism, so the overall shooting effect will be better. Let's compare it with the iPhone. The telephoto effect is very, very obvious. Let's look at the second group. In various low-light conditions, the image quality of the Xiaomi 17 Pro Max's telephoto lens is very, very amazing. Behind it is our sensor, which is 35% larger, and our super-focusing prism technology is also more advanced. Next, because of the large-screen mobile phone, to be honest, This large screen will definitely consume a little more power, so everyone is particularly concerned about the battery life of large-screen phones. In this regard, Apple has done an excellent job. Apple's Pro Max has always had the best battery life in their series. The standard version of our Xiaomi 17 has reached 7,000 mAh. Our 17 Pro Max has 7,500 mAh. This is the flagship phone with the largest battery in Xiaomi's history, 7,500 mAh. Okay, let's take a look at this, right? It also uses the Xiaomi Jinshajiang battery with an ultra-high silicon content of 16% and special-shaped disc battery technology. Then, it supports 100-watt wired charging and 50-watt wireless charging. The product manager reminded me that I must mention that it supports the PPS universal protocol and 100-watt fast charging. Do you understand? This means that other brands' fast chargers can also charge Xiaomi. Do you understand? Not only Xiaomi's chargers can be used, but other people's fast chargers can also charge ours. After the online release, many digital bloggers praised our Xiaomi engineers. At the same time, a comparison of the battery life will show how strong it is. 7,500mAh. Okay, this is our Xiaomi 17 Pro Max. It also has powerful communication capabilities. Its communication capabilities are extremely strong. The signal is strong, the data is stable, and it supports 520 operators in 210 countries. It has extremely strong capabilities. If you often travel abroad, I recommend Xiaomi 17 Pro Max. Okay, let's take a look at the summary. How many new features has it added? It is based on the 17 Pro and has a 6.9-inch OLED straight screen. It also uses nuclear weapons such as super pixels. Its overall clarity is comparable to two thousand, and its power consumption is lower than 1.5 thousand. It also has thick gold glass 3.0 and a super-focused large bottom with shallow telephoto, a 7,500mAh special-shaped disc battery, and super global roaming capabilities. This is Xiaomi 17 Pro Max. Okay, how is this Pro Max priced? We start from 512G. It starts from 512G. Okay, let's take a look at the price. It's set at 5,999. Compared with the Xiaomi 17 Pro with the same memory version, it's 700 more expensive, but it's still very, very affordable. This is all the pricing for the Xiaomi 17 series. You can take a closer look at it. Do you want me to recommend it again? I think not. Everyone should be able to pick the one they like soon. Before the press conference, Mr. Lu repeatedly reminded me that I must introduce the Xiaomi 17 again. Do you want to introduce it? Such a powerful standard version has already been unrivaled in the world. So, Xiaomi 17 is already very powerful. It is not what you call the entry-level version or the castrated version. It is also equivalent to the subpar level of other companies. So our standards are very, very strong. We are also very disciplined in naming, right? So we are still relatively low-key and introverted, right? Okay, the pre-sale has started now. How do we sell it? We will officially put it on the shelves and start selling it at 10 o'clock on September 27. Our Xiaomi Home will also start selling it at 10 o'clock the day after tomorrow morning. So our friends who are watching the live broadcast can come to our store the day after tomorrow to see the real machine and experience it for themselves, okay? Okay, okay, I also want to say here that we have some benefits during the first sale period. If you buy it before October 8, these benefits are quite attractive. We will give you two years of screen breakage insurance and two years of doubled screen breakage insurance. There are also 365 days of replacement only, no repair, okay? Okay, so if you like it, be sure to place an order as soon as possible. Of course, I heard from Mr. Lu that the stock prepared this time should be enough, it should be enough. Okay, speaking of this, I actually want to say one last thing. What is behind the explosive product power of the Xiaomi 17 series? It is a lot of technological innovation. A lot of technological innovation. Xiaomi now invests more than 30 billion yuan in research and development every year. This is actually not a small number. Okay, I won't go into details. We will give a complete introduction to the technology behind these technologies in the media later. Okay, we won't go into details here. Then, we have also designed a liquid silicone protective case specifically for Xiaomi drivers. It supports magnetic suction. It supports magnetic suction. We also have an agricultural fiber protective case that supports magnetic thin plates. When you wear it, the back screen will automatically switch to a customized clock theme. It looks nice, right? In addition, we also have a two-in-one desktop magnetic wireless charger and a car-mounted magnetic wireless charger. Finally, I would like to introduce a newly designed ultra-thin magnetic power bank. This power bank has an all-metal body and is only 6 mm thick. This philosophy guides everything we do, including the products we're going to introduce today and the experiences they provide. From the magical listening experience with AirPods to the ways your Apple Watch keeps you healthy, active, and connected to how iPhone helps you with so many things throughout your day. It's also true of our new software design featuring our innovative Liquid Glass. It brings fluidity, vitality and flexibility to the things you do every day. It's absolutely gorgeous, and delivers a more intuitive and delightful user experience. We bring so much care and consideration to every detail. From every product, service and technology we create to the welcoming nature of our retail stores, design is at the core of everything we do. Today we have a huge day of announcements about AirPods and Apple Watch, and we're taking the biggest leap ever for iPhone. Let's start with AirPods. AirPods are the best and most popular headphones in the world. With an iconic design and groundbreaking sound quality, they have revolutionized the industry and raised the bar for what headphones should be. AirPods deliver a truly magical user experience, from an effortless setup to their amazing sound quality to working seamlessly across your Apple products. Last fall, AirPods Pro took this even further with the world's first end-to-end hearing health experience. It's extraordinary that the world's leading headphones can also make such a meaningful difference to those facing hearing challenges. Today, we're building on these innovations and extending our leadership in world-class audio quality, with the introduction of the next-generation of AirPods Pro. ♪ "BLUH BLUH BLUH" by _BY.ALEXANDER ♪ With breakthrough audio performance and entirely new capabilities, I think AirPods Pro 3 are truly incredible. To tell you more, here's Kate. ♪ "Cisco Bay" by Loaded Honey ♪ At the heart of AirPods is outstanding audio. This year, we pushed ourselves even further and created something truly special. AirPods Pro 3 deliver a breathtaking spatial listening experience. We designed a custom, multi-port acoustic architecture, which precisely controls the airflow that carries sound into the ear. This transforms the bass response. It widens the soundstage so you hear every instrument and brings vocals into stunning focus across music, shows, and calls. And it gets even better with phenomenal Active Noise Cancellation. Ultra low-noise microphones and advanced computational audio combine with new foam-infused ear tips for even greater noise isolation. This significantly improves performance, delivering twice the ANC compared to the previous generation, which were already amazing! These are by far, my favorite AirPods ever. For those with the original AirPods Pro the difference is night and day because this ANC is four times more effective. AirPods Pro 3 are a must-have upgrade, with over-the-ear headphone performance in a pocket-sized design, that removes even more background noise from your daily commute. So, no matter what headphones you've used before, with AirPods Pro 3 you will have the world's best Active Noise Cancellation of any in-ear wireless headphones. Transparency enables you to hear your surroundings and now, your own voice and people speaking to you will sound more natural than ever. And to help connect with those near you, we're bringing the magic of AirPods to the way you communicate across languages with Live Translation, powered by Apple Intelligence! Now, when you are together with someone who speaks a different language, like exploring a market abroad, AirPods Pro will help you understand them in your preferred language. Using a new, simple gesture, Live Translation begins [CHIME] [SIRI] "Translating Spanish" while ANC lowers the volume of the person speaking so it's easier to focus on the translation. [IN SPANISH] - Hello, welcome. - Hi! [SPEAKING IN SPANISH] - Hello, welcome. Today all the red carnations are 50% off. And, it doesn't just translate individual words. The meaning of each phrase is translated for you. When you need to talk, just speak naturally. - I'd love to take some of these to my sister for her birthday. I'll buy eight please. Your iPhone displays your words in their language, and can even read them out loud if needed. [IN SPANISH] Okay! Live Translation is even more useful when both people are wearing AirPods Pro. - I agree, yeah. [IN PORTUGUESE] I agree, yeah. [TRANSLATING IN PORTUGUESE] [RESPONDING IN PORTUGUESE] [TRANSLATING TO ENGLISH] - Definitely, the client will love that. I'll let the strategy team know to prepare that immediately. This incredible capability is enabled by advanced computational audio on AirPods, combined with Apple Intelligence models running on iPhone. Along with incredible personal audio, we're also improving how AirPods Pro fit in your ears. Because people's ears are completely different shapes and sizes, we analyzed more than ten thousand 3D ear scans along with over one hundred thousand hours of user research, to optimize the new AirPods Pro. To fit even more people, we made each AirPod smaller. And to make them fit more securely in your ear, we shaped the design to match the natural geometry of the ear canal. With entirely new ear tips, now in five sizes, all together these are the most stable and best-fitting AirPods ever, engineered to stay in your ears even during the most intense workouts. And, they're also more durable with IP57 sweat and water resistance, a first for any AirPods. So you can feel confident during the sweatiest sessions in the gym or even if you find yourself running in a downpour. These updates are so important for our users who love listening to music when exercising with AirPods Pro. To tell you about how we're taking the fitness experience even further, here's Julz. ♪ Upbeat music ♪ More people work out with AirPods Pro than any other headphones in the world, and now the amazing audio quality, a more secure in-ear design, and enhanced durability make it even better. We're also really excited to add heart rate sensing during workouts with AirPods Pro 3. To do this, we custom built Apple's smallest heart rate sensor. Machine learning algorithms fuse together data from the sensors and accelerometers to deliver precise measurements. This is combined with a new on-device AI model for activity and calorie tracking trained from more than 50 million hours of data from the Apple Heart and Movement Study, which is one of the largest studies of its kind with more than 250,000 participants. This incredible integration between hardware and software takes your fitness experience to the next level with AirPods Pro 3. Now, when you go to the Fitness app on iPhone, you'll see a new Workout experience, where with just AirPods Pro you can track up to 50 different workout types, and it's so easy to get started. This means you can get even more from the activities you love. So when you're listening to music on your daily walk, you can track heart rate and calories burned using the new AirPods Pro. And, you'll have access to audio experiences like Workout Buddy powered by Apple Intelligence to motivate you along the way. [WORKOUT BUDDY] "That's a new record!" "You just walked the longest distance in the walking workout this month." Workouts you complete will also help close your Move ring, contribute to your step count, and you can stay motivated to do even more by earning Awards. In Fitness+ workouts, you can also get metrics like heart rate, calories, and even the Burn Bar to help keep you going. And you can track workouts at the gym including those from developers like Ladder, who can use new APIs to incorporate key metrics into their apps as well. So that's the new fitness experience with AirPods Pro 3. Now, back to Kate. In addition to breakthrough performance across the board, you will also get longer battery life throughout the day. We are moving from six hours on a single charge to eight hours, taking you through that transatlantic flight while listening to music with Active Noise Cancellation. To help our Hearing Aid users, we are thrilled to provide ten hours on a single charge in Transparency. That's four more hours than the previous generation! So that's AirPods Pro 3! Delivering sensational audio performance, including the world's best ANC, an exceptional fit, and innovative fitness capabilities. Whether you've experienced AirPods before, or this is the first time, these AirPods Pro define a new benchmark for the world's most popular headphones. And even with all of these updates, they will still be available for $249. You can pre-order them today, and they will be available September 19th. And now, back to Tim. AirPods Pro 3 are absolutely amazing. They take the audio quality of the most popular headphones in the world to an entirely new level. Next, let's turn to Apple Watch. For millions it's an indispensable daily companion, a fitness coach, message center, mobile wallet and a beautiful timepiece. What I really love about Apple Watch is how it alerts millions of people to potentially serious health issues and helps save so many lives simply by wearing it on your wrist. It provides Fall Detection and Crash Detection, monitors your heart rate, tracks your sleep, is your life line in emergencies and so much more. Let's take a look at the remarkable ways Apple Watch has touched people's lives. [KEYBOARD KEYS TYPING] ♪ Soft music ♪ I'm writing to you regarding my health in relation to my experience with Apple Watch. I just wasn't taking care of myself. I wasn't eating well, terrible schedule. Just like, wasn't sleeping. This is my battle with mental health and how there's always light at the end of the tunnel. I felt I had absolutely nothing left to live for. I just started really slow and it has been nice to see my progress just through fitness and running. Throughout the year I lost over a hundred pounds and I just got into the New York City marathon. It was about five in the morning and my Apple Watch, it started buzzing. My resting heart rate was at 172. I said let me try to sleep this off. Come again, 9:00 a.m., same thing. When they did the X-ray, we found out I had a completely collapsed lung. I needed emergency surgery. It gives me goosebumps almost. And the doctor said, he's like "that Apple Watch just saved your life". I got home and I started to do a jump rope routine. My legs just started to jitter and I hit the ground. Meanwhile my watch is buzzing, so I look at it and it says, "It looks like you're in trouble. Do you need help?" It didn't dawn on me that I was having a stroke. Me and my friend, we were hiking in Japan. On the second day it starts snow storming, and it's just white. I was driving home. I started feeling really off. I started feeling dizzy and that's the last thing I remember. We lost our phones in the snow. We had nothing left. No food, no water. You can't feel your fingers, you can't feel your anything. I don't think I was ready to finish my life there. And what I was wearing was my Apple Watch. We contacted the emergency rescue using the SOS feature. I had a car just crash through the garage. They're upside down in our pool. The next thing I remember was just hearing this very faint voice through my Watch saying, "Help is on the way." "We've got everyone on the way." That helicopter ride was the best feeling I've felt in my life. I've always read those stories about how Apple Watch saved someone's life. That's why I started, to help my mental health. We just completed the first mile. Six miles! I don't know if I can do this. You don't need no medals. One mile to go. Whatever life throws at you, you keep going, you keep pushing and I promise you even in the darkest moments, it will get better. Minutes save lives, you know, seconds save lives. That was my second chance, without this Watch, I probably would not have had. I felt like my Apple Watch had my back. Oh my God, it had my back, it had my front, it had my sides. It had my head. It had my past, my future. Yes, it had everything. It's truly incredible to see how Apple Watch can help people in so many different ways. Its indispensable nature makes Apple Watch the most popular watch in the world. And each year we make Apple Watch even more essential. To tell you what's new, here's Stan. ♪ "We've Got A Good Thing Going" by Tseba ♪ Today, we're making the best watch in the world even better. Introducing Apple Watch Series 11. It's our thinnest and most comfortable watch, and it's even more durable! It starts with our proprietary Ion-X glass, which is the toughest in the industry. We then apply a custom Apple-designed ceramic coating that bonds to the glass at an atomic level, making it significantly harder. So now it's two times more scratch resistant, perfect for everyday use and the challenges of an active lifestyle. With a cellular connection, Apple Watch makes it easy to stay connected when your phone isn't with you. Series 11 now includes the latest cellular technology, 5G! The new 5G modem and antenna architecture improve performance and provide even more coverage. Plus, it's more power efficient, using less battery for cellular. At launch, many of our biggest carrier partners will support 5G on Apple Watch. Series 11 comes with watchOS 26, bringing new features and intelligence, as well as an elegant new design. The new watch face Flow uses Liquid Glass numerals to beautifully refract swirls of color. And Exactograph, a modern reinterpretation of a traditional regulator clock that separates the hours, minutes, and seconds for precise timekeeping. Series 11 also comes with a comprehensive set of health features, including heart, hearing, cycle tracking, mental health, and more. And we're taking that innovation in health even further adding new features in heart health and sleep. Here's Sumbul to tell you more. Heart health has always been integral to Apple Watch. This year, we're thrilled to share our next advancement focused on a problem of massive proportions, high blood pressure, also known as hypertension. It impacts approximately 1.3 billion adults worldwide. The American Heart Association has referred to it as a silent killer because it often occurs with no obvious symptoms. To help, we've developed a groundbreaking feature that can alert you to possible hypertension, just by wearing your Apple Watch. Using data from the optical heart sensor, the algorithm looks for chronic high blood pressure by analyzing how your blood vessels respond to beats of the heart. The algorithm works in the background, reviewing data over 30-day periods, and will notify you if it identifies patterns of hypertension. We developed this novel approach using advanced machine learning methods and a series of studies totaling over 100,000 participants. While it won't detect all instances of hypertension, we expect to notify over one million people with undiagnosed hypertension in the first year alone, empowering them to make lifesaving behavioral changes or start treatment. We expect clearance from the FDA and other regulators soon, with availability in 150 countries and regions this month, including the U.S. and Europe. Now, let's talk about sleep, which is critical to daily restoration of your body and mind, and is also an important factor in your longevity. Apple Watch already helps you meet your sleep goals, gain insights, and discover possible sleep apnea. Now we'll help you understand the quality of your sleep and how to make it more restorative with sleep score. The quality of your sleep is influenced by several factors, such as sleep duration, bedtime consistency, how often you wake up, and the time spent in each sleep stage. Sleep score analyzes these factors each night and provides a classification, plus a score. You'll see how the score is calculated, so it's easy to understand what you can do to improve. Guidance from leading experts, including the World Sleep Society, underpins the scoring approach. And over five million nights of sleep data from the Apple Heart and Movement Study were used to develop and test the scoring algorithms. You can see details in the Sleep app and you can track it over time in the Health app on iPhone. Now, back to Stan. Hypertension notifications, the new sleep score, and the many other incredible health, fitness, and safety features will make a huge impact on users' lives. To support all of these amazing capabilities, we also re-engineered the battery. Series 11 now gets up to 24 hours of battery life, so you can wear it all day and all night. Series 11 comes in Jet Black, Silver, Rose Gold and a beautiful new Space Gray all made from 100% recycled aluminum. There are also gorgeous polished cases made from 100% recycled titanium in Natural, Gold and Slate. This fall brings a beautiful new palette of colors across the entire band lineup. Including the Nike Sport Band and Nike Sport Loop, which now has reflective yarn woven throughout the fabric. And a new Hermès jacquard knit band with matching watch face that plays whimsical animations set in their iconic Paris store. There is also an elegant, narrow Grand H and new colors across the collection. And that's Apple Watch Series 11. With better durability, 5G, 24-hour battery life, and our most comprehensive set of innovative health features, now including hypertension notifications and sleep score. I'll turn it over to Amanda to tell you about the next version of Apple Watch SE. Apple Watch SE delivers the core features and benefits of Apple Watch at the most affordable price. For many people, it's the perfect way to get started. This year we are delighted to introduce Apple Watch SE 3. First, it gets our most powerful Apple Watch chip, S10, which enables even more features. It brings an Always-On display to SE for the first time! Now you can read the time and see the watch face without waking the display. With S10, SE also supports gestures like double tap and wrist flick so you can easily control your watch with just one hand. SE already has important features like heart rate notifications, Fall Detection and Crash Detection. SE 3 adds even more, like wrist temperature sensing which enables retrospective ovulation estimates. And gives you richer insights in the Vitals app, so you can be notified when something might be off. SE also gets sleep apnea notifications and sleep score. Finally, for those moments when you don't have your AirPods handy, you'll be able to play media, like music or podcasts, directly through the speaker. Even with all these great new features, the power-efficient S10 chip enables SE to still get all-day, 18-hour battery life. And for the first time, SE supports fast charging, making it easy to quickly top off the battery. It now charges up to two times faster than the previous model. In just 15 minutes of charging, it can add up to eight hours of normal use. SE 3 comes in a popular Starlight and Midnight, made with 100% recycled aluminum. That's Apple Watch SE 3, featuring a new Always-On display, 5G, temperature sensing, sleep apnea notifications, and sleep score. And with the powerful features of watchOS 26, this update takes SE to a whole new level. Not only did we update SE and Series this year, we are also introducing an all-new version of Apple Watch Ultra. Here's Eugene to tell you all about it. ♪ "JV Gets the $$$" by Junior Varsity ♪ Apple Watch Ultra is the ultimate sports and adventure watch. Ultra seamlessly transitions from a sports watch that helps you train for a race, to a smartwatch that can pay for coffee, to a health monitor that checks your vitals. This year we're taking it further, with Apple Watch Ultra 3. Let's start with the display. Whether you're checking your pace in the sun or depth underwater, readability is crucial. So Ultra 3 gets a new display that uses our most advanced technology with wide-angle OLEDs and LTPO3. The display is now brighter when viewed at an angle. And thinner borders allowed us to grow the screen area without changing the case size. The result is the largest display ever in an Apple Watch. It can also refresh more frequently in Always-On mode without affecting battery life. Which means you can now see ticking seconds in watch faces including a new face, Waypoint, that dynamically shows points of interests in relation to you. For athletes, the Workout app makes it faster to customize views and use Workout Buddy, a generative voice with Apple Intelligence that delivers personalized feedback to motivate you during your workout. And Ultra keeps you connected no matter where you are with 5G cellular for more coverage and a faster, stronger connection. This year, we're also making a huge leap forward with satellite connectivity! Now when you journey off the grid, you can stay safe and in touch with loved ones using satellite in available countries and regions. Just a few taps gathers critical information and can get you the emergency help you need. You can also send messages and share your location with Find My. To enable satellite connectivity in a device as small as Ultra, we redesigned the radio and antenna to double the signal strength, allowing you to communicate with satellites 800 miles above Earth! Emergency SOS via satellite is included with Ultra 3. And along with Messages and Find My, you can now stay connected when you're backcountry skiing, trail running, or wherever you go. Ultra 3 also includes a larger battery and now gets up to 42 hours of battery life. Ultra will be available in Black and Natural Titanium made using an innovative 3D printing process that uses 100% recycled titanium and just half the raw material as previous generations. There are also great new colors across our Ultra bands, and the Trail Loop now includes reflective yarn woven along the edges. The Hermès collection also gets a new band in rubber, perfect for an active lifestyle. And new colors for the En Mer band. That's Apple Watch Ultra 3 now featuring the largest display and longest battery life of any Apple Watch, with satellite communications, 5G, hypertension notifications, and watchOS 26. It's a big update to our most advanced Apple Watch. Now back to Stan. So that's our all-new lineup of Apple Watch. From the new Ultra 3 with satellite connectivity, to Series 11 with new, powerful health features and 24-hour battery life, and SE 3 with a massive update in performance and features. There's a watch that's right for everyone. Apple Watch SE 3 starts at just $249. Apple Watch Series 11 starts at $399. And Apple Watch Ultra 3 starts at $799. You can pre-order all the new models today, and they will be available starting September 19. Now back to Tim. ♪ "We've Got A Good Thing Going" by Tseba ♪ The new Apple Watch lineup and the incredible features they bring make Apple Watch even more useful and essential. The capabilities introduced today will not only help users stay connected, they'll deliver even more health and fitness benefits seamlessly and automatically. Now, let's talk about iPhone. From the moment iPhone was introduced, it reinvented the phone and set a new standard for the entire industry. Since then, we've continued to push boundaries with design, innovation, and experiences that have changed all of our daily lives. Today, we're raising the bar once again, with an all-new iPhone lineup that's unlike anything we've ever created. We're introducing four new models, each designed to serve the unique needs of our users. And it starts now. ♪ "Rainbow" by ATRIP ♪ iPhone 17 is incredible. Here's Kaiann to tell you more. ♪ "Rainbow" by ATRIP ♪ iPhone 17 has a beautiful, more durable design and comes in five gorgeous colors: Lavender, Mist Blue, Black, White, and Sage. The new design has a larger, 6.3-inch display with thinner borders, so you can see more and do more. And the display of iPhone 17 features ProMotion, just like our Pro models, with an adaptive refresh rate up to 120Hz, designed to dynamically respond to your content for a smooth and power-efficient experience. When you're not using your iPhone, the Always-On display efficiently adjusts down to 1Hz. And the Lock Screen is even more useful with Live Activities and widgets. When outside, iPhone 17 is more readable with 3000 nits peak outdoor brightness, our highest ever on iPhone. This makes the display on iPhone 17 our best yet. We build iPhone to be durable, because we know how much people count on it. Our industry-leading Ceramic Shield continues to be tougher than any smartphone glass or glass-ceramic. iPhone 17 introduces Ceramic Shield 2. Now, it has three times better scratch resistance. It's made possible by a new Apple-designed coating, bonded to Ceramic Shield at the atomic level. This specialized ceramic layer adds hardness to protect from everyday scratches. And the display quality gets better with a seven-layer anti-reflective coating that reduces glare and distractions, making iPhone more readable in bright lighting conditions, both indoors and outdoors. Powering iPhone 17 is the latest generation of Apple silicon, A19. Built with the most advanced 3nm technology, A19 is faster and more efficient. It has an updated display engine to power ProMotion and the Always-On display. It has an improved Neural Engine, tailored to power incredible on-device performance for Apple Intelligence. Combined with increased memory bandwidth of A19, on-device generative and large language models will run even faster. A19 has a 6-core CPU with our latest performance and efficiency cores to make iPhone 17 responsive while enabling great battery life. The next-generation 5-core GPU provides a big step up for graphics-intensive tasks. If you're upgrading from an older iPhone, you'll experience a huge boost in speed. The advancements in Apple silicon, hardware, and software make for incredible gaming on iPhone. Titles like Destiny: Rising by NetEase are even better with ProMotion's adaptive refresh rate up to 120Hz. A19's advanced CPU, GPU, and updated neural engine also power Apple Intelligence. There are many features available today on iPhone that empower you to create, communicate, and be more productive. With iOS 26, we are adding even more. With visual intelligence, you can search, take action, and ask questions about what's on your iPhone screen. Live Translation helps you communicate across languages in Phone, FaceTime, and Messages. And just like all of Apple Intelligence, these features are designed to protect your privacy at every step. The efficiency of Apple silicon contributes to all-day battery life on iPhone 17. And with ProMotion, iPhone 17 gets up to eight more hours of video playback compared to iPhone 16. When you are out of battery, faster wired charging gets you up to 50% charge in 20 minutes. So just 10 minutes of charge gives you up to eight hours of video playback. It's also a big year for the iPhone cameras. To show you what's new, here's Megan. ♪ "Bikini" by Nick León & Erika De Casier ♪ iPhone 17 has a fantastic 48MP Dual Fusion camera system. Our Fusion technology combines the capabilities of two cameras in one, with a main camera and an optical-quality 2x telephoto, each with dedicated image pipelines. The main camera delivers an impressive 48MPs of resolution, perfect for capturing fine details, like in this vibrant shoreline photo. And for everyday photos, the 24MP default resolution provides the perfect balance, offering excellent image quality, rich detail, and a smaller file size that's ideal for saving and sharing. At 2x, the optical-quality telephoto gets you closer to the subject, making it great for capturing quiet moments like this. And now, iPhone 17 gets a new 48MP Fusion Ultra Wide camera. It has four times the resolution compared to iPhone 16. So you get even more detail in a broad range of photos, from exceptional macros to expressive scenes in unique angles. You're going to love how easy it is to take amazing photos and videos. Now, let's flip over to the front camera. It's how we take self-portraits, record memories, express our creativity and point of view. And iPhone is with you to capture all these moments. Globally iPhone users took over 500 billion selfies last year. That's more than any other smartphone! So this year, we are thrilled to introduce our phenomenal new Center Stage front camera. It gives you more pixels, more flexible ways to frame your shot, and incredible stabilization. This new front camera has our widest field of view. It is enabled by our largest front camera sensor, almost twice the size of our previous front camera. And for the first time, the sensor is square. Traditional sensors have a 4:3 aspect ratio, which limits framing based on the orientation of the phone. The Center Stage camera's unique shape and larger size allow for high-resolution photos and videos in any orientation, giving you four different compositions. Which means you don't have to rotate your iPhone to take a landscape selfie anymore! Now, you can tap to expand the field of view and rotate from portrait to landscape, giving you more flexible ways to frame your photos and videos. When friends join the shot, the all-new Center Stage for photos uses AI to automatically expand the field of view, and can even rotate the frame for you. 寄件人: "陳俞蓁(yu_chen)" <yu_chen@phison.com>

標籤: UNREAD, CATEGORY_PERSONAL, INBOX

內容:
大家好。 我是 Kouichi Kawamoto， 我將擔任 今天 Nintendo Direct 的導遊之一。 我是 Nintendo Switch 2 的製作人。 [翻譯 2] -我是 Takuhiro Dohta， Nintendo Switch 2 的總監。 [翻譯 3] -我是 Tetsuya Sasaki，Nintendo Switch 2 的 硬體設計主管。 - 您剛剛看到的 是《瑪利歐賽車世界》，它將 在 Nintendo Switch 2 上獨家推出。 現在，您認為 這款全新的瑪利歐賽車遊戲 會是什麼樣子呢？ [音樂結束] [馬裡奧驚呼] [ 巨大的管弦樂鈴聲] [旁白] - 馬裡奧賽車系列的全新作品 將 在 Nintendo Switch 2 系統上獨家推出！ [動感的大樂隊音樂回歸] 歡迎來到這個廣闊的世界。 卡丁車比賽在 全球各地區舉行。 根據一天中的時間 和天氣條件， 氣氛會改變。 [音樂淡出] [巨大的大樂隊叮噹聲] 在這個馬裡奧賽車遊戲中...... 主題: GTC March 2025 Keynote with NVIDIA CEO Jensen Huang

寄件人: "陳俞蓁(yu_chen)" <yu_chen@phison.com>

收件人: "ptest9109@gmail.com" <ptest9109@gmail.com>

日期: Wed, 8 Oct 2025 05:45:11 +0000

標籤: UNREAD, CATEGORY_PERSONAL, INBOX

內容:
這便是智慧的誕生之地，一種新型的工廠， 它會生成詞元 —— 建造 AI 的基石 詞元開啟了一片新天地 帶人們步入非凡世界，孕育無限可能 詞元將圖像轉換為科學數據， 繪製外星大氣雲圖，指引未來的探索者 詞元將原始數據轉化為可靠的預測 讓我們為下一次挑戰做好準備 詞元解碼物理定律，讓我們更快抵達 並且走得更遠 詞元可以提前發現疾病的徵兆 幫助我們解讀生命的語言 並了解人體生理機能的奧秘 詞元幫助我們發掘事物之間的聯繫， 守護地球上珍貴的生物 它將潛能轉化為財富，讓資源變為豐收的碩果 詞元不僅教會機器人如何行動，還給世界帶來歡樂 為我們提供助力 並讓美好生活觸手可及 讓我們攜手並進，勇敢邁步前行 踏入人類未曾涉足之地 這一切，都從這裡開始 歡迎 NVIDIA 創辦人暨執行長黃仁勳 歡迎來到 GTC 大會！ 這一年真是太精彩了 在 NVIDIA，我們一直有一個想法 那就是利用 AI 的魔力，帶大家參觀 NVIDIA 總部 現在，我就帶大家前往 NVIDIA 總部 怎麽樣？ 這就是我們工作的地方，這就是我們的辦公室 這一年來真是精彩紛呈，有很多不可思議的事情可以分享 事先聲明，這次演講我可沒有什麽準備 沒有演講稿，也沒有提詞機， 我有很多事情要講，所以我們趕快開始吧 首先，我要感謝所有贊助商和本屆大會所有優秀的參與者 你們是來自各行各業的代表 醫療健康、交通運輸、零售… 當然還有電腦產業， 電腦產業的大部分人都聚集在此 見到大家真的非常非常高興，感謝你們的支持 GTC 始於 GeForce 一切都是從 GeForce 開始的 今天，我帶來了一塊 GeForce 5090 真不敢相信，已經過去了 25 年 在我們首次推出 GeForce 的 25 年後，GeForce 風靡全球 這是採用 Blackwell 架構的 GeForce RTX 5090 與 RTX4090 相比體積小了 30% 它的能效提升了 30%，而且效能十分驚人 二者幾乎無法比較，原因就在於 AI 技術 GeForce 將 CUDA 帶向世界，CUDA 推動了 AI， 而 AI 現在正回過頭來革新電腦圖形技術 大家現在看到的是電腦圖形實時渲染，100% 路徑追蹤 對於每一個被渲染的像素，AI 都會預測另外 15 個像素的值 不妨深想一下 對於我們用數學計算渲染的每一個像素， AI 都會推斷出另外 15 個像素的值 而且，它必須以極高的精度完成這個過程， 以確保生成的圖像看上去正確 並且符合時序，也就是說，電腦圖形的每一幀， 無論是前一幀還是後一幀，都必須保持良好的時序穩定性 這簡直不可思議 AI 技術已經取得了驚人的進步 而這只是最近 10 年的事 現在我們談起 AI，都會追溯到更早的時候 但 AI 真正受到世人關注，大約是在 10 年前 從感知 AI 開始，包括電腦視覺、語音識別，然後發展到生成式 AI 過去 5 年裡，我們的目光主要聚焦於生成式 AI 嘗試教 AI 學會如何從一種模態生成另一種模態，從文字生成圖像、 從圖像生成文字、從文字生成影片、從氨基酸生成蛋白質、從性質生成化學物質 我們有各種各樣的方式，可以利用 AI 來生成內容 生成式 AI 從根本上改變了運算方式 過去是檢索式運算模型，現在則是生成式運算模型 過去，我們要做的主要是提前創建內容，儲存內容的多個版本， 並在使用時取用我們認為合適的版本 現在，AI 可以理解上下文，理解我們的問題， 理解我們的請求有何含義，然後生成它所知道的內容 如果需要，它還會檢索訊息， 增強對問題的理解，然後再為我們生成答案 它不再是單純檢索數據，而是直接生成答案 運算方式發生了根本性的轉變 運算的每一個層面都發生了變革 過去兩三年裡，重大突破橫空出世 AI 取得了根本性進步 我們將它稱為代理式 AI 基本來說，代理式 AI 是指一種具有自主性的 AI 它可以感知並理解自身所處的情境 更重要的是， 它可以透過邏輯推理來確定如何回答或解決一個問題 它還能制定行動方案 它能夠規劃並採取行動 它甚至能使用工具，因為它現在能理解多模態訊息 它可以訪問網站，查看網站格式、文字和影片，甚至播放影片 它會學習並理解從相應網站獲取的訊息，然後回到工作中， 利用這些訊息和新學到的知識來完成工作 這就是代理式 AI 在代理式 AI 的基礎中，有一些比較新的技術，即邏輯推理 不過，新一輪浪潮又已席捲而來 這也是我們今天要著重討論的話題 那就是機器人技術，這得益於物理 AI 這是一種能夠理解物理世界的 AI 它能理解摩擦力和慣性、因果關系、物體永恆性等物理規律 當物體繞過拐角不見時，並不意味著它從這個宇宙中消失了 它還在那裡，只是看不到了 這種理解物理世界和三維世界的能力，將開啟 AI 的新時代， 我們稱之為物理 AI，它將推動機器人技術的發展 AI 的每一個階段、每一輪浪潮都為我們所有人帶來了新的市場機遇 也為 GTC 帶來了更多新的合作夥伴 所以 GTC 現在座無虛席 要想接待更多人來參加 GTC，我們必須讓聖荷西發展成長 我們正在為此而努力 這里有大量土地可供開發 我們必須讓聖荷西發展成長 這樣才能擴大 GTC 將合作在美國構建用於無線電網路的全端解決方案 這將是第二個軟體堆疊 我們今天宣布的這一堆疊，將把 AI 應用到邊緣 別忘了，全球每年有高達 1000 億美元的資本投資 用於無線電網路和服務於通信領域的資料中心 在我看來，加速運算與 AI 在未來必將融合 AI 能夠更好地調整無線電信號和大規模 MIMO， 使其適應變化的環境和交通狀況 它當然能行 為了實現這一點，我們肯定會用到強化學習 MIMO 本質上是個巨大的無線電機器人 這毫無疑問 因此，我們當然會提供這些能力 AI 當然會革新通訊領域 當我給家裡打電話時，用不著說很多， 因為我妻子知道我在哪裡工作，情況如何 我們可以接著昨天的話題往下聊 她大概了解我喜歡什麽，不喜歡什麽 很多時候，短短幾句話就可以傳遞大量訊息 這是因為我們有背景訊息和人類先驗知識 將這些能力結合在一起，就能革新通訊領域 看看它在影片處理方面的表現 想想我之前在 3D 圖像部分所說的內容 當然，我們也會在邊緣做同樣的事 所以我非常激動，能夠在今天向大家宣布 T-Mobile、Cisco、NVIDIA、Cerberus ODC 將合作構建全端解決方案 AI 正在走進各行各業，通訊只是其中之一 自動駕駛汽車是最早應用 AI 的產業之一 長期以來，我們在電腦視覺領域開展了大量工作 看到 AlexNet 的那一刻，我深受啟發，倍感激動， 正是這一刻促使我們下定決心，全力投入到自動駕駛汽車的開發中 我們研究自動駕駛汽車已經十多年了 幾乎所有自動駕駛汽車公司都在使用我們開發的技術 這些技術會用於資料中心 例如，特斯拉在其資料中心大量使用 NVIDIA 的 GPU 此外，這些技術也可能同時部署在資料中心和車輛上 Waymo 和 Wayve 就同時在資料中心和車輛上使用 NVIDIA 的運算平台 有時，我們的技術僅部署在車內 這種情況較為罕見，但確實存在 其中一些公司使用我們開發的各種軟體 我們與汽車產業合作，汽車產業也希望我們與他們合作 我們打造了三大運算平台：訓練運算平台、模擬運算平台和機器人運算平台， 以及自動駕駛汽車車載運算平台； 還開發了各種在其上運行的軟體堆疊、模型和算法， 就像我剛剛展示的，我們為其他產業所做的那樣 今天，我非常激動地宣布，通用汽車已選擇 NVIDIA 作為合作夥伴， 共同打造其未來的自動駕駛汽車車隊 自動駕駛汽車的時代已經到來， 我們期待在所有三大領域與通用汽車 AI 展開合作 AI 應用於製造業，因此他們可以徹底改變製造方式 AI 惠及企業，他們將徹底改變工作方式、汽車設計和模擬， 然後將 AI 應用到汽車中 因此，為通用汽車提供 AI 基礎設施，與之合作， 並與通用汽車一起構建他們的 AI，我對此感到非常高興 一個我引以為傲，但很少受到關注的領域，那就是安全 汽車安全 我們稱之為 Halos 在我們公司，它叫做 Halos 安全需要技術的全方位支持， 從最底層的矽晶片到整體系統、系統軟體、算法和方法論 涵蓋多樣性、監控、透明度和可解釋性等各個方面 所有這些不同的理念都必須深入到系統和軟體開發的各個環節 我相信，我們是全球第一家對每一行代碼的安全性進行評估的公司 已經有七百萬行代碼通過了安全評估 我們的晶片、系統、系統軟體和算法的安全性均由第三方進行評估， 仔細檢查每一行代碼 這是為了確保代碼設計具備良好的多樣性、透明度和可解釋性 我們已經申請了超過一千項專利 在這次 GTC 大會期間，我強烈推薦大家去參加 Halos 論壇 親眼見證所有這些不同的元素如何結合起來， 共同確保未來的汽車不僅能實現自動駕駛，還能保證安全 我為此感到非常自豪，但很少有人關注這個領域， 所以我想這一次多花點時間來談 好，這就是 NVIDIA Halos 大家都見過自動駕駛的汽車 Waymo 的自動駕駛出租車簡直不可思議 不過我們製作了一段影片， 來跟大家分享一些我們用來解決資料獲取、訓練和多樣性問題的技術 有了這些技術，我們就可以利用 AI 的強大功能來創建 AI 請看影片 NVIDIA 正在利用 Omniverse 和 Cosmos 加速自動駕駛汽車 AI 開發 Cosmos 的預測和邏輯推導能力 支持以端到端訓練的新方法開發 AI 優先的自動駕駛系統 包括模型蒸餾、閉環訓練和合成資料生成 首先是模型蒸餾 作為一種策略模型, Cosmos 通過一種“慢速智慧教師”向“更小更快的學生”轉移知識的方式進行 教師策略模型會展示最優軌跡， 學生模型透過多次迭代學習，直到其表現幾乎達到教師的水平 蒸餾過程可以引導一個策略模型的初始化， 但複雜場景還需要進一步的調整最佳化 閉環訓練讓策略模型能夠實現微調 日誌資料透過 Omniverse Neural Reconstruction 轉化為 3D 場景， 用於閉環和基於物理真實的模擬駕駛 創建這些場景的變體是為了測試模型的軌跡生成能力 然後，Cosmos Behavior Evaluator 會為生成的駕駛行為評分， 以便衡量模型效能 新生成的場景及其評估構成了一個大型資料集， 用於閉環訓練，幫助自動駕駛車輛更穩健地應對複雜場景 最後，3D 合成資料生成增強了自動駕駛車輛適應多樣化環境的能力 利用日誌資料， Omniverse 透過融合地圖和圖像來構建細節豐富的 4D 駕駛環境 並生成現實世界的數位孿生，包括分割訊息， 透過對每個像素進行分類來指導 Cosmos Cosmos 隨後透過生成準確且多樣化的場景擴展訓練資料， 縮小模擬與現實之間的差距 Omniverse 和 Cosmos 使得自動駕駛汽車能夠智慧地學習、適應和駕駛， 讓出行更加安全 NVIDIA 是最適合實現這一切的公司 這就是我們的使命 利用 AI 來重塑 AI 剛才我們展示的技術， 跟現在將帶大家領略的 NVIDIA 數位孿生技術非常相似 我們來談談資料中心 不錯吧？ 用了高斯潑濺技術 高斯潑濺技術 下面我們來談談資料中心 Blackwell 已經全面投產，這就是它的樣子 這非常不可思議，對我們所有人來說， 這是一種美的享受，大家同意嗎？ 怎麽可能不美呢？ 怎麽可能不美呢？ 這是座重要的里程碑，因為我們在電腦架構領域實現了根本性的轉變 我想告訴大家，實際上，三年前我就展示過它的早期版本 我們稱之為 Grace Hopper，系統的名字是 Ranger Ranger 系統大約有銀幕一半寬，它是全球首個 NVL32 系統 三年前，我們展示了 Ranger 的運行情況， 雖然那時它體積龐大，但其理念完全正確 我們一直致力於解決縱向擴展的難題 分布式運算是指利用大量獨立的電腦共同協作， 合力解決超大型難題 但在橫向擴展之前，沒有可以替代縱向擴展的方案 兩者都很重要，但是需要先進行縱向擴展， 然後再進行橫向擴展 縱向擴展極其困難，不存在一蹴而就的解決方案 你無法像 Hadoop 那樣進行橫向擴展 將一大堆商用電腦連接到一個大型網路中， 並使用 Hadoop 進行儲存裝置內運算 Hadoop 是一項顛覆性的創新，這一點毋庸置疑 它使得超大規模資料中心能夠利用普通電腦來解決超大規模的難題 然而，我們試圖解決的問題極其複雜， 如果以那種方式擴展，將會耗費巨大的電力及能源 深度學習也根本永遠都不會出現 因此，我們必須首先進行縱向擴展 這就是我們縱向擴展的方式 我不會把它舉起來 它重70 磅。這是上一代系統架構 它叫做 HGX 這徹底改變了我們對運算方式的認知 這徹底改變了人工智慧 這是 8 個 GPU 8 個 GPU，每一個都是這樣的 這是兩個 GPU，一個 Blackwell 封裝中包含兩個 Blackwell GPU 一個 Blackwell 封裝中包含兩個 Blackwell GPU 這下面還有 8 個這樣的單元 這些單元連接成為了我們所說的 NVL8 然後將其連接到類似這樣的 CPU 機架 這裡有兩個 CPU，位於頂部，我們通過 PCI Express 將它們連接起來 然後許多這樣的單元通過 InfiniBand 連接在一起， 最終形成一台 AI 超級電腦 這是過去的做法 這就是我們一開始採取的方式 這是我們在進行橫向擴展之前， 能夠實現的最高程度的縱向擴展 但我們希望進一步提升縱向擴展能力 我前面提到過，Ranger 接替了這個系統並將其規模擴大了四倍 因此我們有了 NV-Link 32，但是系統過於龐大 所以我們不得不做一些非常了不起的事情， 重新設計 NV-Link 的工作方式和縱向擴展方式 所以我們首先要做的是，我來解釋一下， NVLink Switch 位於這個系統中，嵌入在主板上 我們需要拆解 NVLink 系統，然後把它取出來 這就是 NVLink 系統 好的，這是一台 NVLink Switch 這是有史以來效能最高的交換機 它讓每個 GPU 都能同時與所有其他 GPU 內容:
安德魯·梅恩：大家好，我是安德魯·梅恩，這里是 OpenAI 播客。 在本集中，我們將 與 Andrew Mayne、OpenAI 聯合創始人兼總裁 Greg Brockman 以及 Codex 工程主管 Thibault Sottiaux 進行對話。 我們將討論議程編碼、GPT-5 法典以及 2030 年的發展方向。 格雷格·布羅克曼：我敢打賭，從長遠來看，更高的智力將會成功。 Thibault Sottiaux：它只是針對人們在 Codex 中使用 GPT-5 的目的進行了優化。 格雷格·布羅克曼：你如何確保人工智能產生的東西確實是正確的？ 安德魯·梅恩：我們在這里討論的是法典，首先，自從我在這里使用它的第一個版本以來，我一直在使用它。 現在， 安德魯·梅恩 (Andrew Mayne)：你們有了這個新版本。 我整個周末都在玩它。 我和 安德魯·梅恩對此印象非常深刻。 令人驚奇的是，這項技術在短短幾年內取得了如此大的進步。 安德魯·梅恩：我很想了解早期的故事。 安德魯·梅恩：那麽，使用語言模型進行編碼的想法是從哪里來的呢？ 格雷格·布羅克曼：嗯，我的意思是，我記得在 GPT-3 時代，看到了最初的生命跡象，它獲取一個文檔字符串、一個函數名稱的 Python 定義，然後看著模型完成代碼。 格雷格·布羅克曼：當你看到它時，你就知道這會起作用。 格雷格·布羅克曼：這將會是一件大事。 格雷格·布羅克曼：我記得我們曾經討論過這些理想目標，想象一下如果你能有一個語言模型。 格雷格·布羅克曼：那樣的話會寫出一千行連貫的代碼，對嗎？ 格雷格·布羅克曼：這對我們來說是一個很大的目標。 格雷格·布羅克曼： 格雷格·布羅克曼：令人瘋狂的是，這個目標已經實現並實現了。 格雷格·布羅克曼：我認為我們不會再考慮這個問題，對嗎？ 格雷格·布羅克曼：我認為，在開發這項技術的過程中， 格雷格·布羅克曼：你實際上只會看到漏洞和缺陷， 格雷格·布羅克曼：那些不起作用的東西。 格雷格·布羅克曼：但時不時地，最好退一步來看， 格雷格·布羅克曼：並意識到事情實際上已經 發展到這一步。 Thibault Sottiaux：令人難以置信的是，我們已經習慣了 事物一直在不斷改進。Thibault Sottiaux：以及如何成為日常駕駛員。Thibault Sottiaux：你每天都使用它，然後你回想起一個月前的情況。 Thibault Sottiaux：這根本不可能。 Thibault Sottiaux：這種情況還在繼續發生。 蒂博·索蒂奧：我認為這非常令人著迷，就像人類適應新事物的速度一樣。 格雷格·布羅克曼：現在，我們一直面臨的難題之一是是否要深入某個領域。 格雷格·布羅克曼：對。 格雷格·布羅克曼：因為我們真正來這里是為了 G，對，是為了 AGI，通用智能。 格雷格·布羅克曼：因此，首先，我們的本能就是努力一次性提高所有功能。 格雷格·布羅克曼：編碼一直是例外，對嗎？ 格雷格·布羅克曼：我們確實有一個非常不同的程序，我們用它來關注編碼數據、代碼指標，試圖真正了解我們的模型在代碼上的表現。 格雷格·布羅克曼：而且，你知道，我們也開始在其他領域這樣做了。 格雷格·布羅克曼：但對於編程和編碼來說，這對我們來說是一個非常特殊的關注點。 格雷格·布羅克曼：而且，你知道，對於 GPT-4，我們實際上制作了一個在各方面都有所飛躍的單一模型。 格雷格·布羅克曼：但我們實際上已經訓練過法典模型。 格雷格·布羅克曼：我記得我做過一種類似 Python 的聚焦模型。 格雷格·布羅克曼：我們真的、真的在努力在 2021 年左右提高編碼能力的水平。 格雷格·布羅克曼：我記得我們做 Codex 演示的時候，那可能是我們今天所說的 Vibe 編碼的第一次演示。 格雷格·布羅克曼：我記得構建了這個界面並意識到對於標準語言模型而言，界面、線束非常簡單。 格雷格·布羅克曼：你只是完成了一件事，也許還有後續的轉折或類似的事情。 格雷格·布羅克曼：但就是這樣。 格雷格·布羅克曼：實際上，通過編碼，這段文字就變得生動起來了，對嗎？ 您需要執行它，它需要 內容:
早上好! 歡迎來到 Apple Park 今天我們將揭曉 AirPods 和 Apple Watch 的重磅發布 更會迎來 iPhone 迄今最大飛躍 先來聊聊 AirPods AirPods 是全世界最出色、最受歡迎的耳機 憑借標志性設計和突破性的音質 它不僅顛覆了行業格局 更刷新了耳機的定義標準 AirPods 的用戶體驗妙不可言 設置方便、音色卓越 還能在 Apple 設備間無縫切換 去年秋季，AirPods Pro 更進一步 打造出全球首個端到端的 聽力健康體驗 這意味著世界領先的耳機 也能為面臨聽力挑戰的人群 帶來意義非凡的改變 如今，我們在這些創新之上 進一步引領全球頂級音質體驗 新一代 AirPods Pro 震撼登場 ♪ 突破性的音頻表現和 種種全新功能 讓 AirPods Pro 3 不同凡響 有請 Kate 詳細介紹 ♪ 卓越的音頻性能，是 AirPods 的核心 今年，我們再進一步 打造出獨樹一幟的表現 AirPods Pro 3 帶來令人震撼的 空間聆聽體驗 我們設計了一種定制的多孔聲學架構 可精準控制氣流來傳送聲音 這不僅重塑了低音表現力 還拓寬了音場，讓各種樂器聲聲入耳 在聽音樂、看劇及打電話時 人聲也更突出 而卓越的主動降噪功能 讓這款耳機更出類拔萃 超低噪聲麥克風、先進的計算音頻技術 配合全新的泡沫材料填充耳塞 帶來更好的隔音效果 刷新率會高效降至 1Hz 鎖定屏幕也更實用 能顯示各種實時活動和小組件 戶外使用時 iPhone 17 也更清晰易讀 高達 3000 尼特的戶外峰值亮度 創 iPhone 之最 這一切為 iPhone 17 造就了 我們迄今最優秀的顯示屏 iPhone 的設計制造力求經久耐用 因為我們深知這對用戶有多重要 我們的超瓷晶面板一直業界領先 堅固度超過任何智能手機上的 玻璃或微晶玻璃面板iPhone 17 則帶來了 超瓷晶面板 2 將抗刮劃能力提升至 3 倍 這歸功於 Apple 設計的一種新塗層 它在原子層面與超瓷晶面板接合 這層經特殊處理的瓷晶可增強面板堅固度 幫助抵御日常刮劃 讓這塊顯示屏更優秀的 是七層抗反射塗層 有效減少了眩光和幹擾 讓 iPhone 無論在明亮的室內 還是在戶外使用都更清晰易讀 強勢驅動 iPhone 17 的 是最新一代 Apple 芯片 A19 采用最先進的 3 納米制程工藝打造 A19 速度更快，能效更高 它升級的顯示引擎驅動 ProMotion 技術和全天候顯示 還配備優化的神經網絡引擎 專為 Apple 智能量身定制 成就出色的設備端性能表現 加上 A19 擁有更大的內存帶寬 設備端生成式模型和大語言模型 運行速度會快上加快 A19 有一顆 6 核 CPU 搭載最新的性能核心和能效核心 讓 iPhone 17 響應靈敏 同時還能持久續航 新一代 5 核 GPU 性能飛躍 能從容應對圖形密集型任務 如果你是從舊款 iPhone 升級 將能切實體會到速度的飆升 Apple 芯片、硬件和軟件上的種種提升 讓你用 iPhone 玩遊戲更盡情盡興 網易出品的《命運：群星》等手遊 玩起來更暢快淋漓 因為現在有 ProMotion 的加持 自適應刷新率最高可達 120Hz A19 先進的 CPU、GPU 和升級的神經網絡引擎 也是 Apple 智能的強大推手 現在 iPhone 擁有眾多功能 助你創作、溝通、提高效率 而 iOS 26 讓種種精彩更進一步 有了視覺智能 你就能對 iPhone 屏幕上的 內容進行搜索、操作、提問 實時翻譯功能可助你跨越語言障礙 讓你在電話、FaceTime 通話 和信息 app 中自由溝通 和整個 Apple 智能一樣 這些功能都經過嚴密設計 處處周到保護你的隱私 Apple 芯片能效超高 力挺 iPhone 17 續航一整天 而得益於 ProMotion 技術 iPhone 17 的視頻播放時間 相比 iPhone 16 最多增加了 8 小時 電量耗盡時 有線充電速度也更快 20 分鐘可充至最多 50% 電量 僅需充電 10 分鐘 就夠播放最長 8 小時視頻 今年，iPhone 的攝像頭也有重磅更新 有請 Megan 介紹我們的新成果 ♪ iPhone 17 擁有超讚的 4800 萬像素融合式雙攝系統 我們的融合式技術 將兩種攝像頭性能合為一體 在一顆主攝中，融入 光學品質的 2 倍長焦 各自都配備專用圖像管線 主攝的 4800 萬像素分辨率令人震撼 能拍出有著精致細節的畫面 比如這種格外生動的海岸風光照 而對日常隨拍來說 默認的 2400 萬像素分辨率剛剛好 既保證了出眾畫質和豐富細節 文件占用空間也較小 非常適合保存和分享 光學品質的 2 倍長焦 則讓你拉近拍攝主體 用來定格這樣的寧靜時刻再好不過 現在，iPhone 17 還新配備 4800 萬像素融合式超廣角攝像頭 分辨率高達 iPhone 16 的 4 倍 各種類型照片都能呈現更豐富細節 無論是非同尋常的特寫 還是視角獨到、充滿張力的場景 你將會愛上這種又簡單、又出彩的拍攝體驗 讓我們轉過來聊聊前置攝像頭 我們會用它玩個自拍、記錄生活 揮灑創意、表達觀點 每個美妙瞬間，總有 iPhone 相伴
